title: Hearsay: Who Can Audit the Record a Deployed Agent Harness Writes?
abstract: arXiv:2609.32495v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The record of an agent's run is written by the harness that drives the agent. When the run is later disputed, the auditor was not there and has only this record. We ask whether someone who was not there can check the record, and what decides the answer. It depends on who wrote what a check can rely on: if the harness wrote all of it, the record is only the harness's own word, and we call it hearsay. We build Hearsay, a benchmark that examines the record and not the task: five harnesses run fourteen tasks, model examiners from three vendors and a human panel read the records and answer questions about the runs, and every passage they cite is labelled mechanically by who wrote it. We also audit what is deployed: in all sixteen frameworks, the harness is the only writer. With one writer, readers can name the fault from the record, in up to nine runs in ten, but they cannot check the record. The model examiners claim corroboration

translated_title: 传闻（Hearsay）：谁能审计已部署智能体运行框架所写入的记录？
translated_abstract: 智能体运行的记录是由驱动该智能体的运行框架写入的。当运行过程事后引发争议时，审计者当时并不在场，手中只有这份记录。我们提出的问题是：不在场的人能否核查这份记录，而答案又取决于什么。这取决于检查所依赖的内容由谁书写：如果记录全部由运行框架书写，那么它只是框架自己的单方面陈述，我们将其称为“传闻”。我们构建了 Hearsay，一个审视记录而非任务本身的基准：五个运行框架执行十四项任务，来自三家厂商的模型审查员和一个人类评审小组阅读记录并回答有关运行过程的问题，他们引用的每一段文字都通过机械方式标注其书写者。我们还对实际部署的系统进行了审计：在全部十六个框架中，运行框架都是唯一的书写者。在只有一个书写者的情况下，读者能够在高达十分之九的运行中从记录里指认故障，却无法核查记录本身。模型审查员声称获得了佐证……
tldr: 该论文提出 Hearsay 基准，揭示了一个关键问题：由于已部署的智能体运行框架是运行记录的唯一书写者，审计者虽能从记录中指认故障（高达九成运行），却无法独立核实记录的真实性，使其沦为法律意义上的“传闻”。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Hearsay, a benchmark showing that because deployed agent harnesses are the sole writers of run records, auditors can name faults from the record in up to nine of ten runs yet cannot independently verify the record itself, rendering it mere hearsay.
